content: DNA-LLM benchmark/eval suites: DNABERT-2 repo (ICLR 2024, Apache-2.0) ships the GUE benchmark (28 datasets/7 tasks/4 species) as Google Drive downloads with sample_data/ CSV format docs, results as figure images, BibTeX, CI build check, but no tests or CONTRIBUTING. BEND (gluonfield/BEND, BSD-3-Clause, arXiv 2311.12570) targets biologically meaningful tasks (gene finding, enhancer annotation, chromatin accessibility, methylation, variant effect) with config-driven evaluation (conf/), Sphinx docs on readthedocs, examples, requirements files. Nucleotide Transformer (instadeepai, 923 stars) ships notebooks + docs + pre-commit and hosts a public leaderboard on its site. GUE dataset is mirrored on HuggingFace with a dataset card (leannmlindsey/GUE). Common gap in DNA-era repos: no unit tests; docs strength varies.
